title: Cecilia and Boy in Summer Playsuits, Lawn - Vintage 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length outdoor portrait from the mid-1930s depicting a young boy and girl standing arm-in-arm on a sunlit lawn bordered by leafy trees. The girl wears a quintessential 1930s summer playsuit consisting of a patterned halter top, high-waisted tailored shorts, and white ankle socks with shoes. The boy is dressed in a light-colored knit polo shirt tucked into wide-leg trousers secured with a belt. Their relaxed, confident poses and comfortable casual attire reflect mid-Depression era youth leisure fashion and wholesome family life.
